description: Sentus — blacksmith, portals, BISMUTH defense aura.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Welcome to the Sentus tutorial. The kingdom grows stronger near BISMUTH.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: The Blacksmith captures structures. It is heavily armored but cannot strike air units.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Select the Blacksmith to preview movement — bonus defense near BISMUTH appears on the tiles (up to +3).

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Stay close to BISMUTH to sway fights in your favor.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: The Portal trains every Sentus unit. Select it to open production.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Click the Portal to open production.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Well done! You know how the Sentus fight and build.
